# LocalShare

> LocalShare is a native macOS app for sharing files and text to browsers on the same network, with optional internet sharing through a built-in or self-hosted LocalShare Server.

The macOS Client serves selected content directly. In remote mode, the Client opens an authenticated WebSocket to LocalShare Server; the Server relays requests and streams without storing shared files.

## User documentation

- [Documentation overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/index.md): Product overview and local versus remote sharing model.
- [Client quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/client/getting-started.md): Install and start a local share.
- [File sharing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/client/file-sharing.md): File, folder, preview, upload, and access-boundary behavior.
- [Text transfer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/client/text-transfer.md): File and text sharing with independent LAN and internet reception permissions.
- [Server overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/index.md): Server responsibilities and remote request path.
- [Server deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/deployment.md): Choose a deployment path, install the binary, pair devices, and maintain the Server.
- [Public IP only](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/deploy-ip.md): Direct HTTPS with an IP certificate and automatic renewal; a domain is optional.
- [Existing Nginx and Let's Encrypt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/deploy-nginx.md): Local Server behind Nginx with HTTPS, WebSocket forwarding, and certificate renewal.
- [Existing CDN](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/deploy-cdn.md): Direct relay subdomain or CDN origin configuration, WebSocket, caching, and client IP forwarding.
- [Connect Client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/connect-client.md): Use the default public service or pair a self-hosted Server once; recipients only need a browser.

## Agent workflows

- [Deploy with Codex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/website/server/codex-deploy.md): Copyable prompt and Skill installation guidance.
- [LocalShare Server deployment Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rrbe/LocalShare/master/.agents/skills/localshare-server-deploy/SKILL.md): Reusable instructions for installing and validating LocalShare Server on Linux.
